body.name: Conditionally centered marked-coupling handle
body.construction: At \(d=n\) and \(\sigma=\sigma_n^\star\), replace the common shift in \(\mathrm{def:benchmark\text{-}marked\text{-}family}\) by a bounded mark score centered conditionally on the shared design, couple that score differently to the arm means under \(h=-1\) and \(h=1\), impose exact mass normalization before mixing, and optimize \(\rho_n\) subject to supportwise radius and full-sample total variation at most \(1/3\).
